name: Name
title: StrategIQ - Smart Attendance for Rural Schools

hero.heading: Digitizing Attendance, Empowering Education.
hero.subtitle: A low-cost, user-friendly attendance system using facial recognition, designed for the needs of rural Indian schools.

instant.title: Instant Attendance
instant.desc: Mark attendance for an entire class in seconds using a single photo, saving valuable instructional time.

offline.title: Works Offline
offline.desc: Our system is designed for rural areas. Mark attendance without an internet connection and sync data later.

reports.title: Automated Reports
reports.desc: Generate daily, monthly, and Mid-Day Meal scheme reports with a single click, eliminating manual errors.

accessible.title: Simple & Accessible
accessible.desc: Works on any basic smartphone with no need for expensive hardware. The interface is available in multiple languages.
